title: Whole Six Swept Blades and Open Neck Cage Head
description: One wholly newly authored complete static open-cage cutter-head-inspired unit, posed upright at rest on its own whole annular flange. All numeric profiles and blade lofts newly authored together, no old cutter, spherical cage, propeller, cone or blade mesh imported or extracted. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred at the finite annular ground sole, one complete head prop zero scenes.
